SPY.text: SPY rose about 1.7%, led by Microsoft’s 15.5% post-earnings surge and an 8.2% semiconductor rally after strong cloud growth and lower-than-feared capital spending renewed confidence in AI returns; elevated long-term Treasury yields limited the broader advance.

QQQ.text: QQQ jumped about 3.3% as Microsoft’s strong sales and Azure outlook, paired with lower-than-expected capital spending, drove the stock up 15.5% and sparked an 8.2% rebound in semiconductors, outweighing Meta’s AI-cost-driven decline.
